page.layout: One page of text, centred; the printed lines are the title-page epigraph: a name, an italic citation, and a Latin motto over three lines. Show-through of the mirrored title from the other side lies above and below, and a blue library stamp at left and a faint device at centre-bottom. Nothing in the margins.
page.notes: The mirrored title (CONTROVERSIAE ... CONFESSIO ... CATHOLICAE) above the epigraph, and the faint lines at the foot, are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. The blue oval library stamp at left and the faint woodcut device at centre-bottom are not text. The bracketed "[Belgicus]" and "[Ne-]" are printed brackets, copied as printed. The "&" is the printed ampersand.
